raw: {"found": true, "passages": ["The obligations of the Agent pursuant to this Agreement (other than those set forth in Sections 2(d), 8 and 9 hereof) shall terminate upon the completion or termination or abandonment of the Plan by the Company or upon termination of the Offering, but in no event later than the date (the \"End Date\") which is 45 days after the Closing Date (as hereinafter defined).", "All fees or expenses due to the Agent but unpaid will be payable to the Agent in next day funds at the earlier of the Closing Date (as hereinafter defined) or the End Date.", "In the event the Offering is terminated, the Agent shall be reimbursed for its actual accountable out-of-pocket expenses."]}
